title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description:
Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the **`k`th largest element** in the array.

Note that it is the `k`th largest element in **sorted order**, not the `k`th distinct element.

You must solve it in `O(n log n)` time complexity or better.

**Approaches:**
1. **Sort** and return `nums[n - k]` — O(n log n)
2. **Min-heap** of size `k` — O(n log k)
3. **Quickselect** — O(n) average

```text
nums = [3, 2, 1, 5, 6, 4], k = 2

Sorted descending: [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
                        ^
                    2nd largest = 5
```
